cohort: HIV-positive and negative mothers of infants aged <6 months accessing care in one of five community health clinics in Soweto, Johannesburg, between September 2015 and May 2016 (n=298)
finding: The study found that EBF remains strongly associated with HIV status and that caesarean section was the most common reason mothers delayed breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the most common reason mothers delayed breastfeeding.
